8130: Start on all fours with your knees slightly wider than your hips.
Sit your hips back toward your heels and reach your arms forward.
Let your chest sink toward the floor.
Rock forward and back slowly, then walk your hands to each side.
Breathe deeply and relax your neck.
8141: Set the pulleys at a high position and grab a handle in each hand.
Step forward with a slight lean.
Bring your hands together in a wide arc.
Squeeze your chest as your hands cross.
8142: Lie on your back and loop a band around your feet, holding the ends.
Bring your knees toward your chest.
Press your feet away until your legs are almost straight.
Control the band as it pulls you back.
8143: Grip the bars and lift yourself with straight arms.
Keep your body upright and elbows close.
Lower until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.
8146: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Rest your hands on your lower belly.
Breathe in slowly through your nose and let your belly rise.
Let your pelvic floor and hips soften as you inhale.
Breathe out slowly through your mouth.
Continue for 1 to 2 minutes at a relaxed pace.
8162: Step into a deep lunge with both hands on the floor.
Hold for a breath and feel the front of the back hip open.
Shift your hips back and straighten the front leg.
Flex your front foot and fold gently over it.
Return to the lunge and switch legs.
8188: Stand tall and hold a wall or chair for balance.
Lift one foot slightly off the floor.
Draw slow circles with your toes.
Do about 10 circles in one direction.
8189: Hang from a bar with an underhand grip wider than shoulders.
Pull until your chin is over the bar.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly to a full hang.
8191: Attach an ankle strap and face away from a low cable.
Lift your knee in front of you.
Lower slowly. Switch legs after your set.
8192: Stand with a wide stance, toes turned out, and a dumbbell between your feet.
Hinge down and grab it with both hands.
Keep your chest up and back flat.
Drive through your feet to stand tall.
8193: Set the cable low and stand side-on to the stack.
Hold the handle with both hands.
Pull it diagonally up across your body.
Pivot your back foot and rotate your torso.
Return slowly. Switch sides after your set.
8194: Lie on your back with your legs extended.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Draw your knees up toward your chest.
8195: Sit tall on a chair with feet flat.
Place one hand behind your head.
Return to upright using your side muscles.
8197: Sit upright near the edge of a chair.
Lean forward slightly with a flat back.
Reach one arm forward and the other back, then alternate.
8199: Sit tall on a chair and clasp your hands together.
Raise your arms diagonally up to one side.
Chop down across your body to the opposite knee.
Alternate sides at an easy pace.
